title: Namak Halaal
description: However, Arjun, a young hotel worker who serves Raja faithfully, learns of a plot to kill him and decides to save his boss at any cost.

title: Veer-Zaara
description: The story of Squadron Leader Veer Pratap Singh and Zaara Haayat Khan, of Lahore, during conflict between India and Pakistan.

title: Chhichhore
description: A tragic event reunites college friends as they reflect on friendship, success, and failure. Through humor and emotion, they learn that life's worth isn't defined by victory but by never giving up.

title: Rocky Aur Rani Kii Prem Kahaani
description: Rocky and Rani face cultural clashes, traditions, and generational divides, proving that love thrives despite challenges and family conflicts.

title: Garam Masala
description: Two flirty photographers juggle multiple girlfriends, leading to hilarious confusion. Witty dialogues and comic timing create a chaotic tale of deceit, friendship, and endless misunderstandings.

title: Fighter
description: A team of brave Indian Air Force pilots unite to defend the nation from external threats. With spectacular aerial action, patriotism, and camaraderie, the film honors the spirit of warriors.

title: Sailaab
description: Krishna, who suffers from memory loss, is under the care of Dr Sushma and soon, they fall in love and get married. However, things change when Krishna regains his memory and tries to kill Sushma.

title: Chaloo Movie
description: The police raid a theatre where movie tickets are being sold in black.

title: Nikaah
description: Afaque, who falls in love with Nilofar, is left heartbroken when she marries another man. Things take an unexpected turn when Nilofar gets divorced and Afaque offers her a job at his company.

title: Hichki
description: A passionate teacher with Tourette syndrome turns her weakness into strength while inspiring underprivileged students. Her resilience and empathy redefine success and education.

title: ABCD: Any Body Can Dance
description: Vishnu leads his dance team against powerful rivals, overcoming personal struggles, friendship conflicts and fierce competition to achieve national glory.

title: Dangal
description: Former wrestler Mahavir Phogat trains his daughters to win a Commonwealth Games gold, defying societal norms to achieve his lifelong dream for India.

title: Dilwale
description: Raj and Meera's forbidden love story takes a twist when their siblings fall in love, giving them a second chance.
